name: A-Mem

paper.title: A-Mem: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents

construction.processing: LLM writes keywords, tags, contextual description; note embedded

management.operations: link generation; memory evolution rewrites neighbours' context/keywords/tags

retrieval.candidates: cosine similarity over all notes, plus notes linked in same box

stages.ingestion: Each new interaction becomes one memory note with its original content and timestamp.
stages.construction: An LLM generates keywords, tags and a contextual description for the note; content plus attributes are embedded (all-minilm-l6-v2 in experiments).
stages.organization: Zettelkasten-style network of notes; links are stored on notes and a note can sit in several 'boxes'.
stages.update: Link generation: top-k nearest notes are retrieved and an LLM decides which links to create. Memory evolution: an LLM may rewrite the context/keywords/tags of those neighbouring notes.
stages.retrieval: Cosine top-k over note embeddings (k=10 default, 10-50 per category in Table 8); notes linked within the same box are also returned.
stages.answer: Retrieved notes are inserted into the prompt of the backbone LLM.

summary: Agentic Zettelkasten memory: each interaction becomes an LLM-enriched note that is linked to related notes and can trigger rewriting ('evolution') of older notes' attributes.
notes:
AXES-CHECK: consistent with the seed taxonomy row; the original interaction content c_i is kept and only LLM-generated attributes are rewritten during evolution, hence fidelity tag verbatim+derived. Separate production code: https://github.com/WujiangXu/A-mem-sys.
DESIGN: Sec 3.1-3.4, Sec 4.2, App. A.5 (Table 8). Corrected: 'partly rewritten' clarified (content kept, attributes rewritten); links moved from processing to management.operations.
